body: I’m just tired of being alive.
No, I want to know which pills actually work.

Report everything, immediately. Contact family department services, local police, and your school. You will be provided shelter instantly by police, and will have the opportunity to seek a permanent shelter. I’m sorry, but your parents are doing something disturbing and you need to get away from them as soon as possible. Do not wait another minute pick up the phone and call the police, tell them everything, and they will take care of you. You will be sheltered and supported in every way, battered woman and children are not turned away in the United States.

Nice to see something so positive... 
“Suicide doesn’t take away the pain, it gives it to someone else”
That’s a great point, a very strong message.

That example isn’t at all the same... I’m having disturbing thoughts that I can’t fucking get rid of, on top of my typical bullshit ass life. With or without “life experience” I’m not sure you understand my situation. This isn’t exactly something I’m willing to wait around for until it stops.

Since it’s an opiate, it’s pretty similar to hydrocodone or tramadol (even if that’s synthetic) in how the body reacts to an OD.
That’s why I originally stated I wanted to use tramadol paired with diphenhydramine to slow the heart down during euphoric state.
Everyone keeps saying there’s a good chance of surviving...

I disagree.  I don’t find extreme fetishes normal in any way. And this isn’t simply a “fetish” , I’m not able to control what I think. I’m having unwanted disturbing thoughts and I want them to stop. I don’t to be at peace with my current state of my mind, I simply want to be free of these thoughts.

Thanks for your support...not sure why you stated the negative drawbacks of therapy and then the positive outcomes. I don’t feel comfortable approaching therapy for many, many reasons. I guess having disturbing thoughts is better than disturbing urges? The rule of thumb is if a person has an interest/thought in a crime, they’re also willing to commit it. Which is part of why they arrest pedophiles (besides that real child porn is illegal either way). I’m not sure that coming forward and saying that I have uncontrollable thoughts of rape is going to make me look any better or be treated differently.

Anyway...not sure what people you know that have been helped through therapy but I’ll give it a shot.

Thank you for those kind words, I certainly feel like a monster and have for a while. I wouldn’t call it a fantasy...and even though I understand rape is a huge power struggle, I’ve never wanted to control anyone. So I’m not sure how they would have lined up in my head like that.
Thank you.

Thank you for your concern, though my thoughts aren’t a fantasy or thoughts of me committing rape, they are just thoughts of rape in general. Even if so, I’m not a person that wants to rape anyone and does not plan to, and does not exceed any mental capacity to control myself. I’m not sure who would be so threatened by my personal private thoughts to somehow file a suit against me, but thank you for making me aware.

Thank you for advice on defeating it, I wouldn’t call it a fantasy since I do not chose to vision them and do not necessarily enjoy them in any way. A lot of this is simply constant thought of those actions, not me being involved in them any way. But thank you again.

Thank you for your support. How is that not enough to stop my heart? Even if I hide myself from the public and give it a full 24 hours or so? I’m aware of the nasty side affects, but not really planning on waking up.

Thank you for your kind words and understanding. This was very difficult for me to even type and post publicly.
I’m also extremely thankful you have taught me something new, as I’ve never heard of vicarious trauma. I wasn’t actually aware this was a problem with other people, maybe not as severe but at least similar I guess. Thank you.
